Synopsis:
Kalshi permanently banned ex-congressman George Santos from its platform and fined him $71,356 for insider trading. The action reflects growing compliance pressure on prediction market platforms (Kalshi, Polymarket) as regulators and law enforcement intensify scrutiny of the sector. Santos had previously been reported to the DOJ in June for suspicious trading activity.
